Durov Diagram Coordinates

Source: R/geochemistry.R
durov_data.Rd

Creates Durov-diagram coordinate data from major-ion chemistry.

Usage

durov_data(df, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
durov_data(df, location, analyte, result, unit, sample_date, ...)

# S3 method for class 'env_schema'
durov_data(df, analyte_matching = c("normalized", "strict", "exact"), ...)

Arguments

df

A data frame or `env_schema` object.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

location

Location identifier column.

analyte

Analyte column.

result

Analytical result column.

unit

Reporting unit column.

sample_date

Sample date column.

analyte_matching

Analyte matching strategy. One of `"exact"`, `"strict"`, or `"normalized"`.

Value

A data frame containing Durov plotting coordinates.

Details

`durov_data()` is an S3 generic that supports both raw data frames and `env_schema` objects.

Major-ion concentrations are converted to normalized ionic percentages and transformed into Durov projection coordinates.

Output Variables

Returned data include:

  • major-ion component totals;

  • cation-triangle coordinates;

  • anion-triangle coordinates;

  • `durov_x`;

  • `durov_y`;

  • `durov_x_plot`;

  • `durov_y_plot`.

Examples

data(gw)

durov_data(gw)
